title: --scope user writes only to the harness user folders that exist, and creates AGENTS.md in each, ~/.config/opencode/AGENTS.md included when there is no ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md
source: intended: owner decision (v0.2): JITSO writes instruction blocks to AGENTS.md files only, never to CLAUDE.md
intent: INTENDED behavior (setup instructions writes AGENTS.md only). The home holds exactly one harness user folder (`~/.codex`, `~/.config/opencode` or `~/.pi/agent`, each with a config file and no `AGENTS.md`). `--scope user --yes` creates `AGENTS.md` in that folder (`added=new`), creates no folder for the other harnesses, and never creates `~/.claude`: a folder jitso makes is not a harness install. `~/.config/opencode/AGENTS.md` is created because there is no `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` for OpenCode to fall back to (with one, it is not created: `user-scope-opencode-agents-md-not-created-beside-claude-md`).
